name: warpforge-demo
description: Motion-graphic demo of the WarpForge compiler, built with Remotion

scripts.render: npm run sync && remotion render WarpForgeDemo out/warpforge-demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:gif: npm run sync && remotion render WarpForgeDemo out/warpforge-demo.gif --codec=gif --every-nth-frame=2 --scale=0.5
scripts.still: npm run sync && remotion still WarpForgeDemo
